manifest.name: AnyKey: Keyboard Shortcuts for Any Website
manifest.description: Browse any website from the keyboard: link hints, scroll keys, custom shortcuts for any button, and site presets.

common.deleteBody: This removes the shortcut from every computer you sync with.

recorder.recording: Recording. Press the keys, then pause. Esc cancels.

action.hintsNewTab: Show link hints to open in a new tab
action.goToNewTab: Go to {url} in a new tab
action.hintsNewTabDefault: Open a link in a new tab

popup.unavailable: AnyKey isn't running in this tab.
popup.unavailableHint: If this is a web page, reload it to start AnyKey. Browser pages, such as settings and the extension store, don't allow extensions.
popup.panelKey: Press {keys} to open this panel from any tab.
popup.webPagesOnly: Shortcuts for one site work on web pages only.
popup.offHere: AnyKey is off here, so every key goes to the site.
popup.addHint: Pick something on the page, then press the keys you want for it.
popup.cheatsheetHint: Press {keys} on the page to see every shortcut.

yielded.1: On this page, {keys} runs {site}'s own shortcut instead of AnyKey's.
yielded.n: On this page, {keys} run {site}'s own shortcuts instead of AnyKey's.

popup.hintModeHelp: Press {keys} on the page to label every link and button, then type a label to click it. While labels show, keys pick labels instead of running your shortcuts, until you pick one or press {esc}.

welcome.title: Welcome to AnyKey
welcome.intro: Scroll, click links and switch tabs from the keyboard on any website, and give a key to anything on a page. AnyKey works on this page too, so try its keys as you read.

try.cheatsheet: See every shortcut, on any page
try.hints: Label every link and button, then type a label to click it
try.hintsNewTab: Open a link in a new tab, the same way

welcome.stepOpen: On a website, click AnyKey's button in the toolbar.
welcome.stepOpenKey: On a website, press {keys} or click AnyKey's button in the toolbar.
welcome.stepSetKey: {setKey} to open it from the keyboard.
welcome.stepAdd: Choose {button}, then click what you want a key for: a button, a link, a menu.
welcome.stepKeys: Press the keys you want, then Enter. Pick something else for another shortcut, or press Esc when done.
welcome.pinHint: AnyKey's button starts in the extensions menu, the puzzle piece in the toolbar. Pin it there to keep it in view.

presets.1: {sites} comes with extra shortcuts, and its own keys keep working.
presets.n: {sites} come with extra shortcuts, and their own keys keep working.

welcome.presetsCheatsheet: Press {keys} on one of them to see both.
welcome.settingsHint: Change any key, add your own shortcuts, or turn AnyKey off on a site.

options.title: AnyKey settings
options.problems: Some of your settings need attention. See {link}.

shortcuts.heading: Shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: These work on every site. Changes apply to open tabs right away.
shortcuts.noneYet: None yet. Add one to scroll, switch tabs or open a web address with your own keys.
shortcuts.noPanelKey: No key opens the panel from AnyKey's toolbar button.
shortcuts.panelKey: Press {keys} in any tab to open the panel from AnyKey's toolbar button, even on pages where AnyKey's other shortcuts can't run.
shortcuts.browserHolds: The browser holds the key, so it is set on the browser's page for extension shortcuts.

sites.heading: Sites
sites.intro: Shortcuts for one site, the presets AnyKey has for some sites, and sites where AnyKey is off. To bind a key to something on a page, open the page and use AnyKey's button in the toolbar.
sites.offHere: AnyKey is off on this site, so every key goes to the site.
sites.caption: Shortcuts for {host}
sites.resetBody: The {name} preset's shortcuts go back to their own keys and are all on again, and built-in shortcuts give way to {name}'s keys again. This applies on every computer you sync with.

preset.intro: Shortcuts AnyKey adds on {name}. Your changes to them stay when AnyKey updates the preset.
preset.unverified: Those marked Unverified haven't been tried on the live site yet: if one can't find what it clicks, AnyKey says so on the page.
preset.yieldsHeading: Built-in shortcuts that give way to {name}
preset.yieldsHelp: Where {name} uses one of these keys itself, AnyKey leaves the key to {name}. Keep a shortcut to have AnyKey's run there instead.

keptNote.1: AnyKey keeps the keys on {host}, so {name}'s own {labels} doesn't run.
keptNote.n: AnyKey keeps the keys on {host}, so {name}'s own {labels} don't run.

yieldedNote.1: {name}'s own {labels} gets the keys where it works.
yieldedNote.n: {name}'s own {labels} get the keys where they work.

preset.ownKeysHelp: What {name} does with its keys, as far as AnyKey knows. AnyKey passes them to {name}, except those a shortcut here takes.

settings.sequenceTimeout: Time to finish a key sequence (milliseconds)
settings.sequenceTimeoutHint: How long AnyKey waits for the next key of a sequence such as g g. Default: {default}.
settings.scrollStepHint: How far one press of Scroll up or Scroll down moves. Default: {default}.
settings.hintCharsHint: The keys that link hints are labeled with, the easiest to reach first. They pick labels only while hints show, and run your shortcuts the rest of the time. Default: {default}.
settings.newTabInBackground: Open new tabs behind the current tab

data.heading: Your data
data.intro: Your shortcuts and settings sync to every computer where you're signed in to the browser. Export them to keep a copy or move them elsewhere.
data.noBackup: No backup yet. Importing saves your settings as they were first.
data.backupSaved: Saved on {time}, before your last import or restore.
data.replaceBody: Your current settings are saved as a backup first, so you can restore them from this page.
data.restoreBody: Your settings go back to how they were on {time}. Your current settings become the backup, so you can switch back.
data.repairBody: AnyKey keeps everything this version can read and deletes the rest.
data.repairNewer: A newer version of AnyKey saved these. Updating AnyKey instead keeps all of them.
data.fileExported: The file was exported on {time} and holds:
data.leftOut: Some parts can't be read by this version of AnyKey and are left out: {parts}.
data.ofItem: {used} of {total}. Each part must fit on its own.
data.notSettings: This file isn't an AnyKey settings export.
data.newer: This file comes from a newer version of AnyKey. Update AnyKey, then import it again.

dialog.siteHint: Such as github.com. AnyKey keeps the shortcut with this site's settings.
dialog.pagesHint: A match pattern: {every} is every page of the site, and {issues} only its issue lists.
dialog.selectorHint: A CSS selector such as {id} or {attr}, with {shadow} to step into a shadow root. AnyKey's toolbar button can pick the element on the page for you instead.
dialog.textHint: When the selector finds nothing, AnyKey looks for a button or link with this text.
dialog.urlHint: A full address such as https://example.com, or a path on the current site such as /notifications.
dialog.newTabLinks: Open links in a new tab
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: Shown in the list of shortcuts that ? opens. Leave it empty to describe the action.
dialog.keysHint: Type keys such as {a}, {b} or {c} (mod is ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere), or record them.
dialog.modeHint: Physical keys are written as codes such as {code} and stay put when the keyboard layout changes.
dialog.inInputs: Also works while typing in text fields
dialog.enterSite: Enter a site such as github.com.
dialog.enterSelector: Enter a CSS selector for the element.
dialog.badSelector: This isn't a CSS selector AnyKey can use.
dialog.checkShortcut: Check the shortcut and try again.

errors.keysTooLong: These keys are too long to save. Use fewer keys.
errors.badUrl: Use a web address starting with https://, or a path such as /notifications.
errors.badMatch: Use a match pattern such as *://github.com/*.
errors.between: Use a whole number from {min} to {max}.
errors.hintUnique: Use each character once. Capital and small letters count as the same.
errors.maxKeys: Use at most {n} keys in a sequence.
errors.notModifier: "{piece}" is not a modifier. Use ctrl, alt, shift, meta or mod.
errors.addKey: Add a key after the modifiers. Write the + key as "plus".
errors.modifiersOnly: Add a key besides the modifiers.
errors.shiftedChar: Shift changes the character: write the character itself (such as ? instead of shift+/), or use physical keys.
errors.notCode: "{key}" is not a physical key code such as KeyK or Digit1.
errors.httpOnly: Only http(s) URLs can be opened.
errors.onlyPagesSettings: Only AnyKey's own pages can change settings.
errors.onlyPagesPicker: Only AnyKey's own pages can start the picker.
errors.restart: To add a shortcut, start again from AnyKey's button in the toolbar.
errors.webOnly: AnyKey can add shortcuts only for web pages.
errors.pagesOnly: Only pages can send this request.
errors.notRunning: AnyKey isn't running in this tab. Reload the tab, then try again.

conflicts.shadows: "{label}" doesn't run, because this shortcut uses its keys.
conflicts.waits: Runs after a short pause, because "{label}" starts with the same keys.
conflicts.reserved: The browser keeps these keys for itself, so this shortcut never runs.
conflicts.typing: Also runs in text fields, so you can't type these keys there.

afterNative.1: {site}'s own {labels} runs first, which can stop this shortcut.
afterNative.n: {site}'s own {labels} run first, which can stop this shortcut.

takesNative.1: {site}'s own {labels} doesn't run, because this shortcut takes its keys.
takesNative.n: {site}'s own {labels} don't run, because this shortcut takes their keys.

newer.settings: Your settings were saved by a newer version of AnyKey, so this version won't change them. Update AnyKey, or repair them under "Your data".
newer.global: Your global shortcuts were saved by a newer version of AnyKey, so this version won't change them. Update AnyKey, or repair them under "Your data".
newer.site: Your shortcuts for {host} were saved by a newer version of AnyKey, so this version won't change them. Update AnyKey, or repair them under "Your data".
newer.preset: Your changes to the {preset} preset were saved by a newer version of AnyKey, so this version won't change them. Update AnyKey, or repair them under "Your data".
newer.other: "{key}" were saved by a newer version of AnyKey, so this version won't change them. Update AnyKey, or repair them under "Your data".

damaged.settings: Your settings are partly damaged, so AnyKey won't change them until you repair them under "Your data".
damaged.global: Your global shortcuts are partly damaged, so AnyKey won't change them until you repair them under "Your data".
damaged.site: Your shortcuts for {host} are partly damaged, so AnyKey won't change them until you repair them under "Your data".
damaged.preset: Your changes to the {preset} preset are partly damaged, so AnyKey won't change them until you repair them under "Your data".
damaged.other: "{key}" are partly damaged, so AnyKey won't change them until you repair them under "Your data".

itemQuota.settings: Your settings can use at most 8 KB of synced storage, and this change would pass that. Delete a shortcut first.
itemQuota.global: Your global shortcuts can use at most 8 KB of synced storage, and this change would pass that. Delete a shortcut first.
itemQuota.site: Your shortcuts for {host} can use at most 8 KB of synced storage, and this change would pass that. Delete a shortcut first.
itemQuota.preset: Your changes to the {preset} preset can use at most 8 KB of synced storage, and this change would pass that. Delete a shortcut first.
itemQuota.other: "{key}" can use at most 8 KB of synced storage, and this change would pass that. Delete a shortcut first.

storage.totalQuota: AnyKey can use at most 100 KB of synced storage, and this change would pass that. Delete some shortcuts first.
storage.siteLimit: AnyKey can keep settings for at most 500 sites. Remove some sites first.
storage.damage: This change would damage {name}, so AnyKey didn't save it.
storage.noRepair: That part of your settings needs no repair.
storage.backgroundOnly: Only the background can restore the backup.
storage.onlyYours: Only your own shortcuts can be saved this way.
storage.chooseSite: Choose the site this shortcut is for.
storage.notGlobal: A shortcut for every site can't be saved with one site's settings.
storage.noBackup: There is no backup to restore.
storage.writeRate: The browser limits how often synced settings can change. Wait a minute, then try again.
storage.outOfStorage: AnyKey has run out of synced storage. Delete some shortcuts, then try again.

page.hintsClick: type a label to click it, or press Esc to go back to your shortcuts.
page.hintsNewTab: type a label to open it in a new tab, or press Esc to go back to your shortcuts.
page.noHints: No links or buttons in view.
page.onlyHttp: AnyKey only opens http and https links.
page.gone: That element is gone from the page.
page.notFound: Couldn't find the element for "{label}" on this page.
page.noFocus: "{label}" found an element that can't take focus.

picker.label: AnyKey picker
picker.pick: Pick an element for a shortcut.
picker.instructions: Click it, or press Tab to move and Enter to pick. ↑ selects the parent and ↓ the child. Esc closes the picker.
picker.pointAt: Point at an element, or press Tab to move to one.
picker.saved: Saved "{label}" ({keys}). Pick another element, or press Esc when you're done.

panel.recordingHint: Press the keys, such as g then s, and Enter to save. Works on every page of this site.
panel.typingHint: Type keys such as g s or shift+s, or record them. Works on every page of this site.
panel.newTab: Open the link in a new tab
panel.focus: Focus it, to type in it
panel.title: New shortcut for {host}
panel.pressFirst: Press the keys for this shortcut first.

checkWarnings.1: Recorded {keys}. Check the warning, then press Enter to save.
checkWarnings.n: Recorded {keys}. Check the warnings, then press Enter to save.

panel.enterKeys: Enter the keys for this shortcut, or record them.
